category: managed relational databases (RDS for MySQL, PolarDB) with a time-limited new-user free trial

free_tier.stated: ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL free trial: a 3-month High-availability Edition or Cluster Edition instance with 2 vCPUs and 4 GB of memory. PolarDB Always Free: one 2C8G instance with up to 50 GB storage at USD 0.00 per month, renewed monthly on application.
free_tier.notes: The RDS trial is 3 months and cannot be extended. The PolarDB offer is a monthly $0 application, not a permanent entitlement: each user can participate once a month and the benefit must be re-applied.

per_object_cap.stated: No single-object cap is stated on the pages read; the free ApsaraDB RDS trial instance is provisioned with 2 vCPUs and 4 GB of memory

retention.stated: the 3-month free trial cannot be extended; after the trial expires the instance continues to run and incurs charges until it is manually released; a released instance cannot be recovered
retention.notes: null is not indefinite: the trial is a fixed 3-month window with no extension, after which charges begin rather than data being deleted automatically.

egress.terms: Internet traffic for pay-as-you-go and subscription instances is currently free, including outbound and inbound traffic. Bandwidth is currently unlimited.
egress.free_allowance: unlimited public network traffic (no per-GB charge stated)

interface_detail: the MySQL wire protocol over a public endpoint; an OpenAPI and the Alibaba Cloud CLI
tooling: mysql and psql clients, the Alibaba Cloud CLI, and the DMS database management console
chaining: a free RDS instance can sit behind a tunnel or a compute instance in the same region; the 3-month trial clock is the constraint on any long-lived chain

limits.value: 3-month free trial for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL; the trial cannot be extended and the instance incurs charges after it expires
one free trial per product per user; a released trial instance cannot be recovered or tried again

binding_note: the 3-month, non-extendable trial is what ends the free offer first; the 2 vCPU and 4 GB sizing is the shape of the trial, not the constraint that stops it

identity_cost.detail: Real Name Registration is required: personal developers complete individual certification and enterprise users complete enterprise certification. The offer page states only users that have passed Real Name Registration are eligible. A card is also needed to start a trial: if PayPal is the only payment method the user is prompted to add a credit card, debit card, or PayTM account.

reliability_note: the trial cannot be extended and charges start at expiry; a released trial instance cannot be recovered or re-tried
confidence_note: four first-party Alibaba Cloud and Aliyun pages were captured and quoted on 2026-11-19. No probe was run; the trial clock and identity requirements are stated on those pages.

evidence.quote: You can choose one of the following options: a 3-month High-availability Edition instance with 2 vCPUs and 4 GB of memory, or a 3-month Cluster Edition instance with 2 vCPUs and 4 GB of memory.
evidence.proved: the free ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL trial is 3 months with 2 vCPUs and 4 GB of memory

evidence.quote: The free trial period for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances cannot be extended. After the trial expires, the instance continues to run and incurs charges.
evidence.proved: the trial cannot be extended and charges begin at expiry

evidence.quote: When the usage does not exceed one PolarDB instance of 2C8G (2-core and 8GB of memory), and the storage usage of that instance does not exceed 50GB, there is no fee.
evidence.proved: the PolarDB Always Free allowance is one 2C8G instance with up to 50 GB at no fee

evidence.quote: Each user can participate once a month (maximum). After each successful participation, the free benefits will be valid for the month.
evidence.proved: the PolarDB free benefit is a monthly application, not a standing entitlement

evidence.quote: Only users that have passed our Real Name Registration verification process are eligible to participate.
evidence.proved: Real Name Registration is a gate on the free database offers

evidence.quote: PayPal is not supported for Alibaba Cloud Free Tier. If PayPal is the only payment method in your account, you'll be prompted to add a payment method when attempting to start a free trial. To proceed, add a credit card, debit card, or PayTM account supported by Alibaba Cloud.
evidence.proved: a card or PayTM is needed to start a free trial

evidence.quote: 待领取试用产品的阿里云账号已经完成实名认证：个人开发者需完成个人认证、企业用户需完成企业认证。
evidence.proved: the trial requires real-name authentication: individual certification for personal developers and enterprise certification for enterprise users

evidence.quote: Internet traffic for pay-as-you-go and subscription instances is currently free, including outbound and inbound traffic. Bandwidth is currently unlimited.
evidence.proved: public network traffic has no per-GB charge and no bandwidth cap on paid RDS instances

notes: The ApsaraDB offer is a new-user trial, not a standing free tier: the RDS trial runs 3 months and then bills; the PolarDB Always Free benefit is re-applied monthly. Real-name verification and a card are both gates. A monthly-renewed $0 instance is different from a perpetual free allocation and the record keeps them distinct.
